seoTitle: Keyword Permutation Generator: Combine Word Lists
metaDescription: Combine two to four lists of words into every keyword variation, in one order or all column orders. Up to 50,000 results, free.
intro: Put your modifiers, products and locations in separate blocks and get every combination, optionally in every column order. Copy the list into your keyword tool.
why:
Keyword research often starts with combining modifiers ("buy", "cheap"), products and places. Doing it by hand or in a spreadsheet is slow. This writes every combination at once.

The result is a list of candidate searches, not proof that anyone searches for them. Check them against a keyword tool or your Search Console data. To avoid freezing the browser the tool stops at 50,000 combinations.
howTo: Write each list as one item per line.
Put a blank line between lists (two to four lists).
Choose the joiner and whether to use every column order.
Copy the result into your keyword tool.

faq.q: How many combinations will I get?
faq.a: The product of the list sizes, times the number of column orders if you tick that box.
Yes, set the joiner to nothing, for example for domain name ideas.
